reviews.text: We love our doctor (Hannah). Good, clean clinic with a very reasonable price list. Me and my senior dog feel very well taken care of. Anbefales!
Very satisfied! You get an appointment quickly, good service and good prices. Recommended
Very good and skilled veterinarians. They were very nice and helpful when I was there. Recommended!
First class service and an affordable price.

Castration of female and male cat.

Friendly and gave good information. The wounds were very nice and healed well. Got nice instructions on follow-up after the procedure.
Good price for everything compared to several other providers.
Smooth and thorough visit; perfect handling of our little granny.

We went for a haircut for our little yorkshire terrier. They took her into a room and we heard painful sounds from her. After she was done, we saw that they had cut very deep into most of her nails and she was bleeding. We went and complained and one of the employees sat and laughed (did not apologize and defended herself). We said that this is not right and that we came here because we trusted them. But all they did was defend themselves. My dog ​​is traumatized and has difficulty walking properly. Would never have recommended here.

Oslo's very best animal clinic without a doubt! We have used Friske Dyr på Helsfyr from day 1 with our golden retriever boy. Incredibly nice and professional staff, and not least they have good prices. Highly recommended

I have used healthy animals a few times now and have recommended it to all my friends who have animals! Incredibly good and nice people who work there and not least very good prices. I really appreciate that clinics like this exist. Both of my cats have tooth resorption and the kind prices help me a lot.

Incredibly good help over the phone. The dog was sick and had eaten something it couldn't tolerate. They informed me what to do and she got better. It didn't cost me anything. I've used vets before and had to pay a lot. Lucy has a regular vet now.

Klinikken Guttakrutt
I stopped by a long time ago for a vaccine, and it was a decent experience. But the two guys I met at the reception last time really gave all the help you need and then some. (They were nice to everyone who came in while I was standing there loading)

I stopped by for a milk tooth extraction, and suddenly realized that I had completely forgotten to brag about them. Good price. I think I paid 1900 for all the milk teeth.

Friske Dyr is without a doubt our new vet. Our 5 year old cat Marcello had two teeth pulled and after checking several places we were recommended Friske Dyr, where we were greeted by founder Christian Fantoft Magnesen. All our concerns were taken seriously and Marcello recovered quickly after the procedure. It is so good that there are independent and skilled vets in town, and after going to one of the larger chains for several years, which is owned by a foreign group, it is a relief to feel that both the expertise and price make it possible to take good care of Marcello from now on.

Thank you so much for a great experience!
Skilled staff, nice premises and affordable prices 😻 …
Nice and helpful staff on our first hour here today 🙂 …

We were made to feel incredibly welcome and everything was explained in detail. It was very helpful that the vet Christian called both during and after the surgery to update me. The whole team did a great job, and Max is in great shape despite having 22 teeth pulled. Professional, safe and caring — highly recommended!

We have had three hours at FriskeDyr with our puppy, and are very satisfied! First a health check and vaccination, then a dental check and extraction. She was in good shape after both vaccination and extraction of 10 milk teeth. Skilled veterinarians, good guidance, quick responses to emails, thorough follow-up and record keeping. After the first visit, FriskeDyr became our regular veterinarian.
Nice employees who care about their customers. Shows great care for the animals😃 recommend the place! Reasonable prices than other places. …

I use healthy animals for my elderly cat, and am extremely satisfied with the treatment we receive from veterinarian Kristina! She takes her time and listens to me and takes my animal's health very seriously. I feel that she has gone beyond what one would expect to give me the peace of mind I need. The prices are affordable compared to other veterinarians, and the staff is professional and friendly.
I highly recommend this clinic! The staff is both skilled and pleasant. Here you get good treatment at a reasonable price😊 …

Even though we arrived early in the morning without an appointment due to our dog’s sudden illness, we received immediate help. They really helped Rufi in his suffering, and the price was reasonable. We are very grateful and highly recommend this clinic. We will definitely return when needed :)

Very nice staff! Had booked castration and ID chipping for my cat Leo and I got the appointment half an hour earlier which was nice. The whole thing took about 2 hours and everything was good!

The price is also very good for the service and quality. Highly recommend!

Incredibly happy with the removal of teeth at your place. It looks very good. Christian is very good and very good/nice service at the box office by Mai :) Felt safe and good to drop off the dog. Will definitely come back if I need anything else.

I recommend Friske Dyr på Helsfyr to everyone – both friends, acquaintances and you who are reading this.

They are thorough, clear and genuinely interested in helping. You are greeted with respect, and it is clear that they take both the animal and the owner's situation seriously.

In addition to being fantastically professional, they are also far more affordable than many others – in fact four times cheaper than what I have previously paid at Evidensia.

PS: Thank you so much for helping Sjoko. ❤️
Very good and nice prices.
The world's finest, kindest and most skilled veterinarians who always take their time and always take all symptoms and concerns seriously. Couldn't recommend more ❤️

We had a great experience at the clinic today. The team was professional, caring and very pleasant. They made the visit easy and safe for us and our cat. The prices were also reasonable, which was a pleasant surprise. Highly recommended!
Was greeted with a smile by a nice lady at the reception. Bright, nice premises and a nice veterinarian. Not least, affordable prices. Highly recommended.
Very friendly and receptive.

Highly recommended as it was both very good and cheaper than any other vet we have been to! Simba received caring help from Ellen who was patient and skilled, and got blood tests and x-rays done quickly! Thank you so much!

Nice and professional people, modern and fresh premises. My dog ​​had to have all 4 milk canines pulled. They charge a fixed price (1900 NOK) for milk tooth extraction regardless of how many teeth are to be pulled. Other clinics charge per tooth. I got a price estimate of 8.5 -15,000 for comparison. I was able to pick up my dog ​​after 2.5 hours and she was awake from the anesthesia and doing just fine. I was given good instructions about painkillers, precautions and feeding. My dog ​​was himself the next morning and the sores in his mouth healed in a few days. Nice prices that are competitive on all services/treatments. We will be back! 🐶

Upon arrival, we were greeted by a pleasant person at the counter, and we were allowed in almost immediately – after only a one-minute wait. The vet was very welcoming and took the time to explain what she was examining along the way, which gave us great confidence. She started with an ultrasound and then chose to take an X-ray based on the findings. The entire consultation lasted 50 minutes, and we experienced both professionalism and care throughout.

What impressed us even more was the price – only 4000 NOK for such a thorough examination with both ultrasound, X-ray and blood test. Incredibly good value for money!

We highly recommend Dyreklinikken Friske Dyr and will definitely return if we need help again. Fantastic service and skilled people!

Very satisfied after the first visit. Nice meeting with employee and good treatment of my 12 year old dog who got his teeth cleaned and at the same time had two teeth pulled.
Nice price too. Will continue to use Friske dyr. Highly recommended to others.
Very happy after my chihuahua's tooth extraction. Professional, skilled and accommodating! Highly recommended!

Booked an appointment via the website where there were treatment options that they don't offer. It's nice that they called and informed me about it afterwards but I think they should fix their system instead.
Competent veterinarians, safe and good environment for the dogs (and owner). Good communication during treatments.
Both neutered cats and vaccinated kittens here. Very professional, nice. Quick response on time. Good prices that I hope they continue with. 🌸 …

Used Friske Dyr several times now. So glad I found them. Skilled, pleasant vets and caregivers. Great prices and they tell you unprompted how much the treatment will cost. It took them 5 minutes to make a diagnosis that a larger animal hospital couldn't. Highly recommended!

Cheap & good!

Very happy with Friske Dyr. We had two rehoming dogs who are quite nervous in for teeth cleaning, vaccinations and nail clipping. It was arranged for the dogs to be nervous and the vet was very good with the dogs and informative to us before and after treatment - and all this for half the price of the cost where we went last time😊

Sent an email and asked for a price for a molar extraction on my 13 year old dog, Isabella. Got a response the same day from vet. Christian. The price was half of what my regular vet wanted - and that included teeth cleaning! Was lucky and got an appointment the next day due to a cancellation. Was met by vet. Jostein, who was very nice - and patient with me who was nervous about Isabella due to her age and anesthesia. The procedure went very well. Isabella recovered faster from this anesthesia than the one she had last year at another vet. The next day she was ready to go for a walk in the forest again :) Will definitely come back here if other injuries arise.

I can highly recommend this clinic! Great location and great staff. This is our first visit and we will continue to use the clinic in the future. I have previously used the big chains before (didn't know any better) and was ripped …
Neat, clean and very friendly vets. Always good advice and tips for dental care and more.
Great clinic, with pleasant and competent staff - great care with the animals and really good customer service! We will definitely be back!

Very satisfied, professional and not least very caring. We were so well received and taken care of when our 10 year old Milo had to have his teeth pulled. The next possible vet visit will definitely be here.
